The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-third season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S23|Pokémon Journeys: The Series]], in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Partial collections== ''Pokémon Journeys: The Series'' Collections were released by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. ===Pokémon Journeys: The Series - The Journey Starts Today!=== [[File:Pokémon_Journeys_The_Series_The_Journey_Starts_Today.jpg|thumb|200px|Pokémon Journeys: The Series - The Journey Starts Today!]] Pokémon Journeys: The Series - The Journey Starts Today! was released on DVD on January 11, 2022 by VIZ Media and distributed through Warner Home Video. It contains two discs, with 16 episodes across them combined. Optional English closed captioning is included. Clean versions of the [[The Journey Starts Today|opening and ending themes]] are included as a special feature. ====Contents==== {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Alola}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Alola}}" !
